title: Licence, Tag, and Season Compliance
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch event=regulation
| eval days_to_expiry=round((licence_expiry-now())/86400,0)
| where days_to_expiry<30 OR season_status="closed"
| table item days_to_expiry season_status
description: Tracks your fishing and hunting licences, tags, and open seasons so you always stay within the rules.
value: Fines and bans for an expired licence or closed season are avoidable; a compliance check keeps you legal.
implementation: Log licences and season dates into `index=personal`; alert on expiries and closed seasons.
visualization: Table of licences and seasons needing attention.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your fishing and hunting licences and open seasons, keeping you within the law.
